Identity.History: Ptolemaic Egypt was founded after Alexander the Great’s death when Ptolemy I seized control of Egypt and established a Macedonian Greek dynasty. Centered on Alexandria, the kingdom combined Greek and Egyptian traditions and became a major center of trade, scholarship, and naval power. Dynastic rivalry and Roman intervention weakened the state, which ended after Cleopatra VII and Mark Antony were defeated by Octavian in 30 BC.
